ellie: Hi team, tiny blocker on my docs PR: the SDK code sample for the rollout API uses `wait_for_stable=true` by default but runtime actually defaults it to false. Reviewer flagged the mismatch. Can someone confirm correct default and I'll update the snippet.

sasha: Which SDK/language?

ellie: JS snippet in docs/reference/rollouts.md. Code:```js
const res = await client.rollouts.create({
  model: 'redwood-small',
  strategy: 'canary',
  wait_for_stable: true,
});
```

mike: Runtime default is false (we avoid blocking by default). SDK had an earlier helper that used true, but we changed it to false in last release. The SDK snippet is stale.

sasha: Can you provide the one-liner to replace it with?

ellie: Going to change to `wait_for_stable: false` and add a short comment: `// default: false to avoid blocking deploys`

doc-preview-bot: Docs preview build available: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/branches/ellie/rollout-sdk-default (build 202306-900)

ci-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, linkcheck passed

sasha: pushed change, requested review from @mike.

mike: ACK, LGTM. Merge on approval.

ellie: Thanks folks, resolving the blocker.
